title: Novel-Character Boundary Health
objective: Memastikan Novel dan Character Workspace tetap terpisah setelah migration, link, unlink, delete, backup, restore, dan export.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan tujuh sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; distinct_namespaces failed sementara restore_results failed = FAIL namespaces_unrecovered; unlink_safety failed sementara reference_integrity failed = FAIL unlink_broke_references; reference_integrity failed sementara restore_results failed = FAIL references_unrepaired; delete_safety failed sementara restore_results failed = FAIL delete_unrecovered; override_isolation failed sementara permission_boundary failed = FAIL override_leak_uncontained; permission_boundary failed sementara restore_results failed = FAIL permission_breach_unrepaired; kegagalan terdeteksi yang pulih jujur (restore_results recovered/ok tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; boundary telemetry workspace produksi live belum diamati.
Fault test destruktif atas data pengguna, restore end-to-end pada data nyata, verifikasi perangkat keras, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
